$comment: Bulkhead dev protocol (P2.6): JSON-RPC 2.0 methods a running dev build answers. Shared by the in-page client (rpc.discover), the dev bridge and the MCP server (scripts/mcp-bulkhead.mjs). Modelled on Bevy's Remote Protocol (BRP).

rpc.discover.description: List the methods and their parameter schemas.

sim.state.description: Session state: preset, tick, sim time, dev mode (auto|run|hold) and speed.

world.query.description: List live entities with their component ids. Filters combine with AND.

with.description: Component ids the entity must have, e.g. ["sdk/transform3d"].

name.description: Substring of the scene node name (sdk/scene-node).

entity.set.description: Replace one component (or deep-merge with merge: true). value null removes the component.

sim.pause.description: paused: true holds the simulation; false keeps it running even with menus open; omitted toggles.

sim.resume.description: Back to normal: the simulation runs while the player is playing.

sim.step.description: Run n fixed ticks now and stay held.

sim.speed.description: Time scale for real-time play (0.25 = slow motion, 4 = fast).

input.press.description: Hold or release a key / button by code (KeyW, Space, Mouse0, GamepadA). Ticks are needed for it to take effect.

preset.apply.description: Validate and start a preset. keepState re-applies the current snapshot when the preset id and plugin set match.

config.describe.description: Config fields (type, range, default) and current values of every active plugin.

config.set.description: Set one plugin config value and restart, keeping state when possible. value null resets to the default.

replay.run.description: Re-simulate a .replay.json headlessly in the page and compare its final hash.

screenshot.description: PNG of the game view (with the debug-draw overlay when on) as a data URL.

draw.set.description: Toggle debug drawing and the physics collider overlay.
